latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Editing with NAS skill.
- Edit videos directly from your NAS with simple text instructions—no need for complex software.
- Supports popular formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV) up to 500MB per file.
- Automatic setup connects to the cloud render API; no manual installation required.
- Upload clips, describe edits (trim, transitions, export), and receive edited videos in 1–2 minutes.
- Manage sessions, check credits, and track state natively within the workflow.
